function leaves(uint256) view returns (address engineer, string reason, bool approved, bool processed, address processedBy)
function faults(uint256) view returns (uint256 id, address substation, string description, bool resolved, address resolvedBy, string rectificationReport)
event LeaveApplied(address indexed engineer, uint256 indexed id, string reason)
event LeaveProcessed(uint256 indexed id, bool approved, address indexed processedBy)
event FaultReported(uint256 indexed id, address indexed substation, string description)
event FaultRectificationSubmitted(uint256 indexed id, address indexed engineer, string report)
event FaultResolved(uint256 indexed id, address indexed engineer)
